sql: SELECT inet_server_addr()::text AS server_address, inet_server_port() AS server_port, current_database() AS database_name, current_user AS role_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(DISTINCT movement_adjusted_sk) AS distinct_movement_keys, MAX(movement_date) AS latest_movement_date, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01') AS october_movement_count, ROUND(SUM(brl_amount) FILTER (WHERE movement_date >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND movement_date < DATE '2026-11-01')::numeric, 2) AS october_signed_brl_amount, clock_timestamp() AS observed_at FROM public.rpt_inflow__movement_adjusted;
